note: Closed vocabulary of Raise Capacity rejection keywords used by the Rejection Explanation Agent. Every keyword is detected deterministically by Python from a CONFIRMED failure in the Academic Eligibility Evaluation Agent's evidence (satisfied is false; for the prerequisite, also verified is true). Unresolved or unverifiable evidence (satisfied is null / verified is false) never maps to a keyword. Gemini may only reference these ids and can never create new ones. 'topic_terms' are used to reject generated explanations that discuss a requirement that did not fail. Prerequisite keywords follow the UoS relationship type: SINGLE/AND use prerequisite_not_completed / prerequisite_not_passed (every listed course is required); OR uses prerequisite_options_not_satisfied (any one option is enough). completed_hours_insufficient uses its 'development_rule' variant unless the rule's status in course_completed_hours.json is 'approved', so a development-only threshold is never presented as confirmed university policy.

prerequisite_not_completed.label: Prerequisite course not completed
prerequisite_not_completed.policy_basis: The course prerequisite published on the official University of Sharjah degree page must be satisfied before registering in the course.
prerequisite_not_completed.plain_reason: There is no record of the required prerequisite course(s) {course_ids} in your transcript.
prerequisite_not_completed.supportive_guidance: The prerequisite course(s) {course_ids} need to be completed with a passing grade before this requirement is met.

prerequisite_not_passed.label: Prerequisite course not passed
prerequisite_not_passed.policy_basis: A prerequisite course counts as satisfied only when a passing grade (A, B+, B, C+, C, D+ or D) is recorded under the approved grade policy.
prerequisite_not_passed.plain_reason: No passing grade is recorded for the required prerequisite course(s) {course_ids}; the recorded attempt has a failing grade or is still in progress.
prerequisite_not_passed.concise_reason: no passing grade recorded for prerequisite course(s) {course_ids}
prerequisite_not_passed.supportive_guidance: A passing grade needs to be recorded for the prerequisite course(s) {course_ids} before this requirement is met.

prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.label: No prerequisite option satisfied
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.policy_basis: The course prerequisite published on the official University of Sharjah degree page lists alternative options; completing any one option with a passing grade (A, B+, B, C+, C, D+ or D) satisfies it.
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.plain_reason: The prerequisite for this course can be satisfied by any one of the following options: {options}. None of these options has been completed with a passing grade: {status_details}.
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.concise_reason: none of the prerequisite options ({options}) completed with a passing grade
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.supportive_guidance: Completing any one of these prerequisite options with a passing grade would satisfy this requirement.
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.status_never_attempted: there is no record of course(s) {course_ids} in your transcript
prerequisite_options_not_satisfied.status_not_passed: no passing grade is recorded for course(s) {course_ids}

completed_hours_insufficient.label: Insufficient completed credit hours
completed_hours_insufficient.policy_basis: This course requires a minimum number of completed credit hours under approved University of Sharjah policy.
completed_hours_insufficient.plain_reason: You have completed {student_completed_hours} credit hours, while this course requires at least {required_hours} completed credit hours.
completed_hours_insufficient.concise_reason: {student_completed_hours} completed credit hours, minimum required is {required_hours}
completed_hours_insufficient.supportive_guidance: At least {required_hours} completed credit hours are needed before this requirement is met.

development_rule.label: Completed credit hours below the evaluation criterion
development_rule.policy_basis: A minimum completed-credit-hour threshold for this course is configured in the project's local knowledge base as a development rule. It has not been confirmed as official University of Sharjah policy.
development_rule.plain_reason: You have completed {student_completed_hours} credit hours, which is below the minimum of {required_hours} completed credit hours applied for this course in this evaluation.
development_rule.concise_reason: {student_completed_hours} completed credit hours, below the minimum of {required_hours} applied in this evaluation
development_rule.supportive_guidance: Under the criterion applied in this evaluation, at least {required_hours} completed credit hours would be needed.

no_remaining_capacity.label: No remaining raise capacity
no_remaining_capacity.policy_basis: A Raise Capacity request can only be accommodated while the section's current enrollment is below its maximum allowed capacity (total capacity plus additional capacity).
no_remaining_capacity.plain_reason: Section {section_id} is at {current_capacity} against its maximum allowed capacity of {maximum_allowed_capacity}, so no additional raise capacity remains.
no_remaining_capacity.concise_reason: Section {section_id} has no remaining capacity (maximum allowed capacity {maximum_allowed_capacity})

fallback_templates.formal: The Raise Capacity request for course {course_id} ({course_name}), Section {section_id}, does not meet the following academic condition(s) evaluated for this request. {plain_reasons}
fallback_templates.supportive: Thank you for your Raise Capacity request for {course_name}. After reviewing the academic conditions for this request, it does not currently meet the following condition(s). {plain_reasons} {supportive_guidance}
